text: Healthy living means taking care of your body and your mind. First, eat a balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables, and whole grains, and try to avoid too much sugar and fast food. Regular exercise is also important; even a short walk every day can make a big difference. Don't forget to get enough sleep, because good rest helps you think clearly and feel better. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance by spending time with family and friends and enjoying your hobbies.
